requiredFindings.title: Bind the logging exception to the single accepted adapter and its actual operability resolution
requiredFindings.detail: The host/lib.rs exception uses unanchored text.replace on every exact adapter body and does not require one top-level occurrence or prove that opensip_operability resolves to the accepted crate. A duplicate or nested exact body under a local alias can be erased while its bridge lives in an unscanned host module, allowing a forbidden finalize authority to evade the source guard. Require exactly one anchored accepted adapter, reject shadowing or aliasing of opensip_operability, and add duplicate/nested and alias controls with fresh owning and mutation evidence.
